thread:
jess: Customer reported billing mismatch for AcmeCorp — invoice shows ~12,311 tokens missing compared to their audit ledger.

oliver: they ran `redwood-meter report --from 2024-07-01 --to 2024-07-31` and attached CSV, invoice id INV-202407-998. counts: agent=1,123,457 ; ledger=1,135,768 ; diff=12,311

maria: can you paste agent diag and last few agent logs? also what's agent version and whether it's behind NAT/load-balancer?

oliver: agent version 1.4.6, running on customer VM behind private NAT. logs: 
```
2024-07-31T10:12:02Z INFO  buffer.flush started count=4096
2024-07-31T10:12:03Z WARN  store: write error: io timeout
2024-07-31T10:12:05Z INFO  buffer.flush completed acked_up_to=12345
2024-07-31T10:12:05Z ERROR dropped_events count=42 prev_seq=12299 found_seq=12372
2024-07-31T10:12:05Z INFO  heartbeat local=2024-07-31T10:12:05Z server=2024-07-31T10:11:17Z offset=-48s
```

ashok: hm — pattern looks like interleaved flush + transient store error => flush retries may have replayed older batch after ack advanced, causing seq gaps in ledger. Coupled with clock skew (offset -48s) can make events appear out-of-order to the collector, which dedups or drops.

ashok: previous bug we fixed in 1.4.7 — `ordered-acks=false` optimization could ack before durable commit if transient errors -> leads to missing writes on replay. Customer on 1.4.6 still vulnerable.

maria: repro steps for customer to collect full evidence:
1) enable debug log: `sudo systemctl set-env REDWOOD_LOG=debug && systemctl restart redwood-meter`
2) run diag: `/opt/redwood-meter/bin/diag --since 2024-07-01 --outfile /tmp/diag.tgz`
3) capture ledger tail: `sqlite3 /var/lib/redwood/meter.db "SELECT * FROM ledger ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 200;" > /tmp/ledger_tail.txt`
4) send `/tmp/diag.tgz`, `/tmp/ledger_tail.txt`, and invoice CSV`

jess: we'll open escalation ticket (#ESCL-6319) and mark high priority. propose next steps: ask customer to upgrade to 1.4.7, run diag, and we'll run audit reconcile. if they can't upgrade immediately, enable `agent.ordering.strict=true` as workaround.

ton y: tagging billing — @tony we may need provisional credit for 12,311 tokens until we reconcile.

sre-bot: Incident created: ESCL-6319 | Priority: P2 | Assignee: eng-ml

oliver: customer ok with upgrade window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. also asked for ETA on credit.

maria: I'll take the upgrade coord, ashok will do root-cause and a patch if needed.

ashok: plan: reproduce locally with a simulated store failure + clock shift, run end-to-end ingest -> collector -> ledger, verify missing count, produce patch to force durable commit before ack. repro steps posted to ticket.

jess: thanks team :thumbsup: we'll follow up in ESCL-6319 and post final reconciliation details here.
